guardrails: Presentation layer only: no providers/controllers/repositories/models/routes/DTO changes; 747 behavior tests must stay green.
Preserve every widget public API and the 15 M3 TextTheme slot names so screens inherit the re-skin for free.

Preserve the founder-approved accessible saffron split: fill/CTA #C2410C, text/icon #A8380A, brand-decorative #FF9933 only; dark #F6A959 fill with #231200 label. theme_contrast_test.dart must stay green.
Every text pairing passes WCAG AA (ratios stated in the spec); >=48dp targets; 12sp minimum.
11 Indic scripts: serif+sans dual Noto fallback, line-height floors, zero clipped matras verified on Bengali/Tamil/Malayalam at textScale 1.3 / 360dp / light+dark.
Lucide icons only, no emoji, no em dashes, teacher-dignity copy, all 11 languages first-class (never Hindi-only).
Saffron surface area < 10% of any screen; one CTA glow, never repeated; no mesh gradients, no glassmorphism, no gradient behind body text, no gradient-filled text.

Motion curve set is exactly easeOutQuart/emphasized/standard; single element <=420ms, orchestration <=600ms wall-clock, input never blocked >350ms; bounce/elastic/linear-on-reveal banned; respect MediaQuery.disableAnimations.
Branch develop; commit each unit; git add explicit paths (never -A/.); never push, never deploy, never touch sahayakai-main or sibling repos.
Any DESIGN_RUBRIC 15-point FAIL blocks that screen's commit.

relaxations.change: Add 14 to the allowed .circular() radius set (8/10/12/14/16/20); add card=16/control=12/well=14 aliases to the radius table.
relaxations.why: IconWell v2 gradient well uses r14 — an on-scale premium value, not drift.

relaxations.change: Replace 'single canonical curve / >400ms FAIL' with the sanctioned 3-curve set (easeOutQuart/emphasized/standard), 420ms single-element ceiling, ~600ms multi-element wall-clock orchestration, input never blocked >350ms. Bounce/elastic still banned.
relaxations.why: One curve cannot drive both a 160ms tap and a 320ms page push; the emphasized/standard pair is the minimum premium motion needs.

relaxations.change: Replace the flat .04/.08/.12 grammar and the 'darker than .12 FAIL' line with the two-layer warm-tinted e1-e4 system (e4 reaches .20) + dark 1px top-highlight + one CTA glow.
relaxations.why: The flat .04 shadow on white is imperceptible — the #1 cheap-utility-app tell; real depth is the biggest premium lever.

relaxations.change: Expand the sanctioned gradient list beyond the accent bar to: paper wash (3%), hero corner wash (8% saffron), dark vignette, CTA glow, ribbon, IconWell tint. Still ban mesh, glassmorphism, gradient-filled text, gradient behind body text.
relaxations.why: The premium language legitimately needs tasteful, barely-there warm gradients; the old rule banned all but one.

relaxations.change: Add pine (#12554A/#4FB3A2) and indigo-ink (#22346B/#8DA4E0) as sanctioned tertiary accents alongside saffron/green/navy. Still ban glassmorphism and purple/indigo AI-slop-as-primary.
relaxations.why: A 3-note accent story gives the palette a grown-up spread so it never reads as 'M3 + one orange button'.

relaxations.change: Supersede the flat-white light and blue-black dark tables with the Ivory & Ink / warm-espresso values (+ new named tokens lPrimaryText/lShadowBase/brandBrass/pine/indigo); record Fraunces as the editorial display family and mark Outfit retired.
relaxations.why: The tables are the named-token-only gate's source of truth and must reference the shipped premium values.

designDoneChecklist: Paper not white: warm ivory ground, cards visibly float (1.13:1 lift + warm two-layer shadow); no two coplanar whites.
Depth is legible: every card casts a gathered warm two-layer shadow; the one focal card sits a step higher; dark cards show a top catch-light.
Serif present and restrained: Fraunces on wordmark/heroes/card+result titles (~3-6 strings/screen), Inter elsewhere, clear serif<->sans contrast, no Outfit.
Sections read editorial: every group has a saffron tracked-uppercase (Latin) eyebrow + hairline rule; no weak grey labels.
Saffron scarce and confident: <10% surface; #C2410C fills, #A8380A text, #FF9933 only on splash/logo; dark CTA reads brass not neon; no all-peach tiles.
The three moments land: Splash presses the Seal + draws the ink underline; Dashboard opens as a composed Almanac; results ink in block-by-block on a DocumentSheet (never a chat dump).

Motion confident not playful: staggered entrances, press-depress everywhere, skeletons (no bare spinner), Lift-&-Settle push, result reveal, all within 3-curve/<=420ms(<=600ms) budget; reduce-motion shows final frame instantly.
A11y holds under stress: every text pair AA; 48dp targets; longest Bengali+Tamil+Malayalam render no clipped matra at textScale 1.3/360dp/light+dark; Lucide-only, no emoji; dignified copy.
Looks curated not generated: composed asymmetry, masthead, seal, hairline discipline, tabular data.
